jei.resonantinstruments.attunement.vital: Obtain by striking an Unattuned Fork against a fully grown crop or a breedable animal.
Once tuned, the Harmonic of Vitality accelerates crop growth and triggers animal breeding without food when used nearby.
jei.resonantinstruments.attunement.reson: Obtain by striking an Unattuned Fork against bedrock at the absolute bottom of the world.
Once tuned, the Harmonic of Resonance mines any block, gaining higher mining levels the more it is used.
jei.resonantinstruments.attunement.chron: Obtain by striking an Unattuned Fork against an Enchanting Table at exactly midnight.
Once tuned, the Harmonic of Chronos will tick-accelerate blocks, enabling them to complete their processes faster.
jei.resonantinstruments.attunement.alche: Obtain by infusing an Unattuned Fork with a potion at a Resonance Chamber.
Once tuned, the Harmonic of Alchemy becomes a reusable potion wand, applying its stored effect to the user or a target entity.
jei.resonantinstruments.attunement.divin: Obtain by striking an Unattuned Fork against a Budding Amethyst.
Once tuned, the Harmonic of Divination points toward the nearest block matching whatever material it was last used on.
jei.resonantinstruments.carving.obtain: Right-click any log to strip it. Right-click a Stripped Spruce Log with the Carving Knife to carve it into a Resonance Chamber, then right-click the Chamber again to carve it into a Harmonic Node.
jei.resonantinstruments.carving.desc: The transformation only works on spruce, and each step cannot be undone. The Carving Knife has 128 uses before it breaks.
